title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 1,851–1,900 個單字（CEFR A2 初級）

examples.en: The teacher guided students to analyze the poem stanza by stanza.
examples.zh: 老師引導學生逐節深入分析這首詩。

examples.en: Data scientists analyze millions of website clicks to optimize user experience.
examples.zh: 資料科學家剖析分析數百萬筆網站點擊數據，以全面優化使用者體驗。

examples.en: Blood samples were sent to the university laboratory to analyze potential virus strains.
examples.zh: 抽取的血液樣本被火速送往大學實驗室，以深入分析潛在的病毒株類型。

examples.en: Detailed market analysis is crucial before launching a new product.
examples.zh: 推出新產品前，詳盡的市場分析至關重要。

examples.en: A blood test analysis revealed that her iron levels were slightly below normal.
examples.zh: 血液檢驗報告分析顯示，她的體內鐵質含量略低於一般標準正常值。

examples.en: Financial analysts provided an in-depth analysis of the quarterly stock market rally.
examples.zh: 金融分析師針對本季股市強勁反彈背後的成因提供了極為深入的專業剖析。

examples.en: Compare prices online before making big electronic purchases.
examples.zh: 購買高單價電子產品前先在線上比價。

examples.en: Don't compare your personal learning pace with classmates around you.
examples.zh: 切勿將自己個人的學習步調與身旁同儕盲目攀比，保持節奏即可。

examples.en: Poets frequently compare the fleeting beauty of youth to blossoming spring flowers.
examples.zh: 詩人經常將青春稍縱即逝的耀眼美好，比喻為春日裡絢爛盛開的花朵。

examples.en: In comparison with last year, student test scores improved noticeably.
examples.zh: 與去年相比，學生的考試成績有了顯著提升。

examples.en: A side-by-side spec comparison helps shoppers select the right smartphone.
examples.zh: 並列規格的詳細對照表，能協助精打細算的消費者選出最理想的智慧型手機。

examples.en: There is simply no comparison between fresh home-cooked soup and canned broth.
examples.zh: 現煮現燉的美味家常鮮湯與市售罐頭高湯相比，品質完全不可同日而語。

examples.en: The bright orange sunset forms a dramatic contrast with dark blue mountains.
examples.zh: 明亮的橙色日落與深藍色山巒形成鮮明的對比。

examples.en: In stark contrast to his noisy brother, Mark is soft-spoken and contemplative.
examples.zh: 與吵鬧外向的哥哥形成強烈對比的是，馬克為人說話輕柔且深思熟慮。

examples.en: The essay contrasts life in a crowded metropolis with life in a peaceful farming village.
examples.zh: 這篇專題短文深入對比了繁華擁擠的大都會生活與寧靜質樸的鄉村農莊歲月。

examples.en: Can you describe your hometown's unique geographical features in English?
examples.zh: 你能用英文描述家鄉獨特的地理特徵嗎？

examples.en: The eyewitness described the fleeing suspect’s height and clothing accurately.
examples.zh: 目擊證人向執法員警極為準確地描述了逃逸嫌疑人的身高特徵與穿著衣物。

examples.en: Words fail to adequately describe the awe of standing atop the snow-covered peak.
examples.zh: 任何言語文字都難以貼切描繪親身矗立在白雪皚皚的山巔時內心的極致震撼。

examples.en: The online hotel description matched our wonderful vacation experience.
examples.zh: 網路上對飯店的介紹說明與我們美好的度假體驗完全相符。

examples.en: Read the official job description carefully to understand required qualifications.
examples.zh: 投遞履歷前務必先詳讀官方職缺說明，充分了解該職位所需的各項專業資格。

examples.en: The sunset over Kenting beach was so breathtaking it was beyond all description.
examples.zh: 墾丁海灘上那場絕美無比的落日晚霞壯麗動人，簡直筆墨難以形容。

examples.en: The science teacher explained how solar eclipses occur naturally.
examples.zh: 自然老師解釋了日食在自然界中是如何發生的。

examples.en: Can you explain why the software update broke backward compatibility?
examples.zh: 你能否詳細說明一下，為什麼本次軟體版本更新會破壞向後相容性？

examples.en: Let me explain the rules of the board game before we begin playing.
examples.zh: 在我們正式擲骰開局之前，先由我來為大家詳細解說這款桌遊的遊玩規則。

examples.en: His clear explanation helped everyone understand the complex math theorem.
examples.zh: 他深入淺出的解說幫助大家理解了複雜的數學定理。

examples.en: The airline provided a formal explanation regarding the unexpected gate change.
examples.zh: 航空公司針對登機門臨時突發異動一事，向全體候機旅客提出了正式說明。

examples.en: Is there any reasonable scientific explanation for these peculiar light phenomena?
examples.zh: 針對這些神秘奇特的夜空異常發光現象，目前是否存在合理的科學原理解釋？

examples.en: Field guides help birdwatchers identify native bird species accurately.
examples.zh: 圖鑑指南能幫助賞鳥者準確辨識本土鳥類品種。

examples.en: Can you identify the person who accidentally dropped this wallet in the hallway?
examples.zh: 你能指認辨識出究竟是誰不小心把這只黑色皮夾遺落在長廊走道上的嗎？

examples.en: Many young adolescents strongly identify with the heroic main character of the novel.
examples.zh: 許多年輕青少年對這部奇幻小說中經歷磨難的英勇主角產生了強烈的情感認同。

examples.en: Summarize the main idea of the reading paragraph in two sentences.
examples.zh: 用兩句話總結閱讀段落的核心大意。

examples.en: At the end of the meeting, the project manager summarized upcoming milestones.
examples.zh: 在會議即將散會之際，專案經理精準扼要地總結了下一階段的重要里程碑。

examples.en: The news anchor took thirty seconds to summarize the primary findings of the report.
examples.zh: 新聞主播花了短短三十秒鐘時間，概括總結了這份國際調查報告的核心結論。

examples.en: Write a brief one-page summary of today's meeting decisions.
examples.zh: 撰寫一份一頁長度的今日會議決議摘要。

examples.en: In summary, regular aerobic exercise combined with sleep significantly boosts vitality.
examples.zh: 總結而言，維持規律有氧運動搭配充足優質睡眠，能大幅提升個人的身心活力。

examples.en: An executive summary gives busy company executives a rapid overview of the proposal.
examples.zh: 執行摘要能讓日程滿檔的企業高層決策者迅速掌握整份商業企劃書的精髓。

examples.en: We concluded the team presentation with a lively Q&A session.
examples.zh: 我們以熱絡的問答環節為團隊簡報劃下句點。

examples.en: Scientists concluded that volcanic activity caused the ancient climate disruption.
examples.zh: 地質科學家經過縝密研究後得出結論，判定古代氣候巨變係由劇烈火山活動所致。

examples.en: The international trade agreement concluded after eighteen months of talks.
examples.zh: 經過長達整整十八個月的艱辛談判，雙方最終順利敲定締結了這項國際經貿協定。

examples.en: What conclusion did you draw from the laboratory experiment?
examples.zh: 你從這項實驗室實驗中得出了什麼結論？

examples.en: In conclusion, adopting eco-friendly daily habits safeguards our planet for children.
examples.zh: 總而言之，在日常生活中養成綠色環保好習慣，是在為子孫後代守護美麗地球。

examples.en: Do not jump to hasty conclusions before reviewing all empirical evidence objectively.
examples.zh: 在全面客觀審視所有實證數據證據之前，千萬切忌妄下過早且草率的結論。

examples.en: Please consider all options before making a final career choice.
examples.zh: 作出最終職業抉擇前請考慮所有可行選項。

examples.en: Have you ever considered studying abroad in an English-speaking country?
examples.zh: 你是否曾經認真考慮過前往英語系國家展開海外留學深造的計畫呢？

examples.en: Many colleagues consider him to be the most patient mentor in the company.
examples.zh: 公司許多同仁一致認為他是整家企業中最具耐心、提攜後進最用心的好前輩。

examples.en: Thank you for your kind consideration of my job application.
examples.zh: 感謝您撥冗考慮我的求職應徵申請。

examples.en: Commuter safety must be the foremost consideration in railway route engineering.
examples.zh: 通勤旅客的搭乘安全，必須是整條鐵路軌道路線工程規劃中最首要的考量因素。

examples.en: Showing thoughtful consideration for the elderly earns genuine societal respect.
examples.zh: 處處為年長者著想並展現細膩體貼的關懷之情，能贏得整個社會發自內心的敬意。

examples.en: Teachers evaluate students based on both coursework and exam performance.
examples.zh: 老師根據平時作業與考試表現綜合評估學生。

examples.en: The engineering committee will evaluate structural damage after the typhoon.
examples.zh: 結構工程專家委員會將在颱風過境後，親赴現場嚴格評估建築物結構損壞程度。

examples.en: Investors evaluate financial statements thoroughly before purchasing shares.
examples.zh: 穩健的投資人在大筆買入上市公司股票前，一定會對其財務報表進行徹底評估。

examples.en: Use flashcards to memorize twenty new English words daily.
examples.zh: 使用單字卡每天背誦並熟記二十個新英文單字。

examples.en: Actors must memorize dozens of pages of script dialogue before rehearsals begin.
examples.zh: 專業演員在劇組正式排練開始前，必須把數十頁長度的劇本台詞熟記於心。

examples.en: It is far more effective to understand mathematical formulas than to memorize them blindly.
examples.zh: 深刻理解數學公式背後的推導邏輯，遠比死記硬背公式本身有效得多。

examples.en: I have fond memories of childhood camping trips in Kenting.
examples.zh: 我對童年時期在墾丁露營的時光有著美好的回憶。

examples.en: My grandfather possesses an astonishing memory and easily recites poems from memory.
examples.zh: 我祖父擁有驚人的超強記憶力，信手拈來便能不看稿熟練背誦古典詩詞。

examples.en: Upgrading your laptop's memory from 8GB to 16GB significantly speeds up multitasking.
examples.zh: 將筆記型電腦記憶體由 8GB 升級擴充至 16GB，能顯著提升多工作業運行速度。

examples.en: I can vividly recall our first English lesson together.
examples.zh: 我能清晰回想起我們一起上的第一堂英文課。

examples.en: As I recall, the neighborhood convenience store closes at midnight on weekdays.
examples.zh: 就我的記憶所及，街角那家巷弄超商在平日工作天通常是於午夜十二點打烊。

examples.en: The automobile company issued a voluntary safety recall for five thousand vehicles.
examples.zh: 這家知名汽車大廠主動針對存在潛在安全隱患的五千輛新車發布了自主召回令。

examples.en: Please remind me to buy milk on the way home.
examples.zh: 回家路上請提醒我買牛奶。

examples.en: That sentimental melody reminds me of peaceful summer evenings at Grandma's house.
examples.zh: 那首動人的懷舊旋律總讓我想起童年時期在外婆家度過的寧靜恬適夏日傍晚。

examples.en: The flight attendant gently reminded passengers to fasten their seatbelts during turbulence.
examples.zh: 航程遭遇氣流顛簸時，空服員溫柔親切地提醒客艙全體旅客務必繫妥安全帶。

examples.en: Set a calendar reminder on your phone for the dentist appointment.
examples.zh: 在手機日曆上為看牙醫的預約設定提醒。

examples.en: This automated email serves as a friendly reminder that your monthly subscription renews.
examples.zh: 本封系統自動發送的通知信旨在溫馨提醒您，您的月繳訂閱服務即將自動續約。

examples.en: The yellow post-it note stuck to his monitor was a constant reminder to drink water.
examples.zh: 貼在電腦螢幕邊框上的黃色便利貼，是他時時刻刻提醒自己多喝水的貼心備忘。

examples.en: Find a quiet corner in the library so you can concentrate.
examples.zh: 在圖書館找個安靜的角落，這樣你才能專注讀書。

examples.en: It is dangerous to text on your smartphone while driving because you cannot concentrate.
examples.zh: 開車行進間低頭滑手機傳訊息極其危險，因為這會使駕駛完全無法集中注意力。

examples.en: Elite athletes concentrate completely on their breathing before the starting pistol fires.
examples.zh: 頂尖運動員在起跑發令槍鳴響前的那一刻，會全神貫注於自己平穩深沉的呼吸。

examples.en: Studying in short intervals helps maintain sharp mental concentration.
examples.zh: 分段讀書有助於維持敏銳高度的專注力。

examples.en: A sudden loud honk from a truck shattered his concentration during the online exam.
examples.zh: 線上遠距考試進行中，窗外卡車突然傳來的刺耳大喇叭聲打斷了他的高度專注。

examples.en: The chemist measured the exact salt concentration of the saltwater solution.
examples.zh: 化學分析實驗員精確量測並記錄了該鹽水配方溶液中的確切食鹽百分比濃度。

examples.en: Constant smartphone notifications distract students from studying.
examples.zh: 頻繁的手機推播通知會分散學生的讀書注意力。

examples.en: Loud construction drilling next door distracted everyone in the office meeting.
examples.zh: 隔壁工區傳來的巨大鑽牆施工噪音，讓會議室內開會的每位同仁頻頻分心。

examples.en: The magician waved a colorful silk scarf to distract the audience during the trick.
examples.zh: 魔術師在表演關鍵手法時，刻意揮舞五彩絲巾藉以巧妙轉移觀眾的視線注意力。

examples.en: Put your phone in another room to eliminate study distractions.
examples.zh: 把手機放在另一個房間以排除讀書時的分心誘惑。

examples.en: Watching a comedy movie provided a welcome distraction from her stressful exam week.
examples.zh: 看一部輕鬆搞笑的喜劇電影，為她緊繃高壓的期末考週帶來了極受歡迎的舒壓消遣。

examples.en: A clean, uncluttered workspace minimizes visual distractions while writing code.
examples.zh: 保持工作桌面整潔有序、毫無雜物，能將撰寫程式碼時的視覺干擾降至最低。

examples.en: Did you notice the bulletin board notice about tomorrow's schedule change?
examples.zh: 你有注意到公布欄上關於明天行程異動的通知嗎？

examples.en: I suddenly noticed a tiny scratch near the corner of my camera lens.
examples.zh: 我突然驚訝地注意到，我的單眼相機鏡頭邊角處有一道細微的淺淺刮痕。

examples.en: Employees must give at least two weeks' formal notice before resigning from their post.
examples.zh: 依照公司規定，員工在正式離職生效日前至少必須提前兩週遞交正式書面預告。

examples.en: Students used microscopes to observe onion cell structures.
examples.zh: 學生使用顯微鏡觀察洋蔥細胞構造。

examples.en: Drivers are required by law to observe all posted school-zone speed limits.
examples.zh: 法律明文規定駕駛人行經校園周邊時，必須嚴格遵守告示牌標示的限速規範。

examples.en: Many families across the world observe traditional cultural customs during spring.
examples.zh: 每年春暖花開之際，世界各地的許多家庭都會隆重慶祝並恪守古老的傳統習俗。

examples.en: Record your experimental observations carefully in the lab notebook.
examples.zh: 將實驗觀察結果仔細記錄在實驗筆記本上。

examples.en: The doctor kept the head-injury patient overnight for routine medical observation.
examples.zh: 針對頭部遭受撞擊的受傷病患，主治醫師安排其住院留觀一晚進行例行醫療觀察。

examples.en: His sharp observation about market trends impressed the venture capital investors.
examples.zh: 他對當前消費市場演變趨勢的敏銳洞察與精闢針砭，讓創投投資人印象深刻。

examples.en: I could barely recognize my old classmate after ten years!
examples.zh: 十年後我幾乎快認不出我的老同學了！

examples.en: Face ID technology uses infrared sensors to recognize the smartphone owner instantly.
examples.zh: 臉部解鎖技術利用紅外線感測矩陣，能在一瞬間精準認出手機主人的臉龐。

examples.en: The university recognized her outstanding academic contributions with an honorary degree.
examples.zh: 該名校為了高度表彰她在學術研究領域的卓越傑出貢獻，特別頒授榮譽博士學位。

examples.en: I suddenly realized that I had left my EasyCard at home.
examples.zh: 我突然意識到我把悠遊卡忘在家裡了。

examples.en: It took decades of persistent dedication for the visionary baker to realize his dream.
examples.zh: 歷經數十年如一日的堅定奉獻，這位充滿抱負的烘焙大師終於實現了自己的夢想。

examples.en: Only when you live completely alone do you realize how much your parents sacrificed.
examples.zh: 唯有當你真正完全獨立在異鄉生活時，你才會深刻意識到父母當年的無私付出。

examples.en: Never assume; always ask questions to clarify facts.
examples.zh: 切勿妄加揣測；務必主動發問以釐清事實。

examples.en: I assumed the bookstore was open, but it was closed for inventory counts.
examples.zh: 我原本一廂情願以為書店有開門，沒想到今天正逢內部庫存盤點暫停營業。

examples.en: The newly elected director will assume full operational responsibility next Monday.
examples.zh: 新當選接任的營運長將於下週一正式承擔起全公司整體日常營運的管理重任。

examples.en: Check your facts to ensure your reasoning isn't based on false assumptions.
examples.zh: 核實事實以確保你的推論並非建立在錯誤的假設上。

examples.en: The economic forecast relied on the optimistic assumption that fuel prices would stabilize.
examples.zh: 這份經濟成長預測完全建立在一個樂觀的假設前提上，即國際油價將會回穩。

examples.en: It is a dangerous assumption to believe that walking alone in unlit alleys is always safe.
examples.zh: 盲目認為深夜獨自漫步在沒有路燈照明的昏暗僻靜小巷絕對安全，是危險的臆斷。

examples.en: Meteorologists predict a sunny and pleasant weekend ahead.
examples.zh: 氣象學家預測即將迎來一個晴朗舒適的週末。

examples.en: It is nearly impossible to predict the exact moment an earthquake will occur.
examples.zh: 想要百分之百精準預測強烈地震究竟會在何年何月何秒爆發，幾乎是不可能的。

examples.en: Economists predict that artificial intelligence will create entirely new job categories.
examples.zh: 經濟學家樂觀預測，生成式人工智慧的興起將會催生出前所未見的全新就業類別。

examples.en: The weather prediction for tomorrow is scattered afternoon showers.
examples.zh: 明天的天氣預測為午後零星短暫陣雨。

examples.en: His confident prediction that our school basketball team would win turned out true.
examples.zh: 他先前信心滿滿預測我們學校籃球隊必能問鼎奪冠，事後證明果然成真。

examples.en: Climate modeling predictions help coastal communities build effective seawalls in advance.
examples.zh: 氣候變遷電腦模型預測數據，協助沿海城鎮居民得以及早構築堅固防浪海堤。

examples.en: I will definitely join the weekend hiking trip to Yangmingshan!
examples.zh: 我這個週末一定會參加去陽明山的健行活動！

examples.en: If you visit Tainan, you should definitely try the famous beef soup for breakfast.
examples.zh: 如果你造訪古都台南，清晨早餐絕對必須品嚐遠近馳名的現沖溫體牛肉湯。

examples.en: She was definitely the most hardworking student in the entire chemistry class.
examples.zh: 毫無疑問地，她是整間化學課堂上公認平日讀書態度最認真刻苦的好學生。

examples.en: It will probably rain this afternoon, so take an umbrella.
examples.zh: 今天下午很可能會下雨，所以出門記得帶傘。

examples.en: He is not answering his phone; he is probably driving on the highway right now.
examples.zh: 他一直沒接電話，現在這個時間點八成很可能正開車行駛在高速公路上。

examples.en: Learning a musical instrument is probably one of the most rewarding hobbies in life.
examples.zh: 學會演奏一門樂器，大概是人生中最能滋養心靈且最具成就感的美好嗜好之一。

examples.en: Could you possibly help me carry this heavy parcel upstairs?
examples.zh: 您能否可能幫我把這個沉重的包裹搬上樓？

examples.en: We cannot possibly finish this lengthy coding assignment before midnight tonight.
examples.zh: 我們無論如何都絕不可能在今晚午夜十二點鐘響前寫完這份龐大的程式作業。

examples.en: Could this ancient pottery shard possibly be from the prehistoric Neolithic era?
examples.zh: 這片在田野間偶然出土的古老陶器碎片，有沒有可能出自新石器時代史前遺跡？

examples.en: You are absolutely right about the importance of daily practice.
examples.zh: 關於每日練習的重要性，你說得完全正確。

examples.en: The panoramic ocean view from the seaside cliff was absolutely breathtaking.
examples.zh: 從陡峭的濱海懸崖極目遠眺遼闊無垠的大洋，景致絕對令人屏息讚嘆。

examples.en: Do you agree that we need more bicycle paths? — Absolutely, without a doubt!
examples.zh: 你贊同我們市區應當增設更多自行車專用道嗎？— 絕對完全贊成，毫無疑問！

examples.en: May I ask a question? — Certainly! Go right ahead.
examples.zh: 我可以問個問題嗎？— 當然可以！請便。

examples.en: Practicing daily listening will certainly improve your spoken English fluency over time.
examples.zh: 只要天天堅持練聽力，假以時日必定能大幅提升你的英語口語流利表達水準。

examples.en: I will certainly visit my grandparents during the upcoming long holiday weekend.
examples.zh: 在即將到來的連續假期長假期間，我必定會專程南下探望敬愛的阿公阿嬤。

examples.en: I thought it was difficult, but it is actually quite straightforward.
examples.zh: 我原本以為很難，但實際上相當簡單明瞭。

examples.en: Did you know that tomatoes are actually fruits rather than vegetables botanically?
examples.zh: 你知道從植物學嚴謹分類上來看，番茄實際上屬於水果而非蔬菜嗎？

examples.en: She didn't fail the driving exam; she actually passed with a near-perfect score!
examples.zh: 她路考根本沒有被扣分不及格，事實上她居然以近乎滿分的超高成績順利通過！

examples.en: Taiwan's fresh tropical fruits are delicious, especially the sweet mangoes.
examples.zh: 台灣的新鮮熱帶水果非常美味，尤其是香甜的芒果。

examples.en: This windproof jacket is especially useful when riding a scooter on chilly winter nights.
examples.zh: 寒風刺骨的冬日夜晚騎乘機車時，這件連帽防風外套顯得格外好用保暖。

examples.en: Children especially love splashing around in shallow water during hot summer afternoons.
examples.zh: 炎炎夏日的午後時分，小孩子們尤其喜歡在清涼的淺水池畔開心地打水仗嬉戲。

examples.en: Winters in southern Taiwan are generally mild and dry.
examples.zh: 南台灣的冬季通常溫和且乾燥。

examples.en: Generally speaking, older generations prefer traditional tea to modern iced coffee.
examples.zh: 一般而言，長輩族群普遍偏好沖泡傳統溫熱茶葉，更甚於現代冰咖啡。

examples.en: Public transit across Taipei is generally recognized as exceptionally safe and clean.
examples.zh: 台北地區的大眾捷運運輸系統普遍被公認為具備極佳的整潔度與絕佳的治安。

examples.en: Trains run frequently between Taipei and Banqiao stations.
examples.zh: 台北車站與板橋站之間的列車班次非常密集頻繁。

examples.en: Tourists frequently visit the historical temple to take photos and sample snacks.
examples.zh: 來自世界各地的觀光旅客經常頻繁造訪這座歷史宮廟，拍照打卡並品嚐在地小吃。

examples.en: Software developers frequently back up their code repositories to cloud storage.
examples.zh: 軟體工程師平日工作時會極為頻繁地將手頭的程式碼備份儲存至雲端代碼庫。

examples.en: It rarely snows in low-altitude areas of Taiwan.
examples.zh: 台灣低海拔平地地區極為罕見下雪。

examples.en: He rarely eats fast food because he prioritizes fresh, home-cooked vegetables.
examples.zh: 他平時極少吃油炸速食，因為他總是堅持三餐必須攝取現煮新鮮蔬果。

examples.en: Endangered leopard cats are rarely spotted by daytime hikers in mountain woods.
examples.zh: 白天健行的登山客極其罕見能在深山密林中親眼目擊瀕臨絕種的石虎身影。

examples.en: The baby was so tired she could hardly keep her eyes open.
examples.zh: 小寶寶太累了，簡直連眼睛都快睜不開了。

examples.en: The acoustics in the hall were so poor that we could hardly hear the speaker.
examples.zh: 大講堂內部的音響效果實在太差，我們坐在後排簡直幾乎聽不清楚講者的聲音。

examples.en: There is hardly any milk left in the carton; please pick up another bottle.
examples.zh: 牛奶紙盒裡頭幾乎連一滴牛奶都不剩了，下班路過超商請順手再買一瓶回來。

examples.en: After hours of patient climbing, we eventually reached the mountain peak.
examples.zh: 經過數小時的耐力攀爬，我們終於登上了山頂。

examples.en: Keep practicing your English dialogue every day and you will eventually become fluent.
examples.zh: 只要天天堅持開口練習英文日常對話，假以時日你終究必定能夠說得無比流利。

examples.en: Following long and arduous legal trials, justice was eventually served in court.
examples.zh: 歷經漫長且艱難的司法訴訟程序，正義公理最終在法庭上得到了昭雪與伸張。

examples.en: Call the emergency 119 number immediately in case of fire.
examples.zh: 若發生火災請立即撥打 119 緊急報案電話。

examples.en: When you notice a scooter tire puncture, stop immediately in a safe parking area.
examples.zh: 當你察覺機車輪胎不慎被刺破漏氣時，應當立刻將車輛安全滑行停靠在路旁空地。

examples.en: She responded immediately to my text message with helpful directions to the cafe.
examples.zh: 她在收到我的求助簡訊後第一時間秒回訊息，指引我前往那家隱密咖啡館的捷徑。

examples.en: Have you watched any good Taiwanese movies recently?
examples.zh: 你最近有看什麼好看的台灣本土電影嗎？

examples.en: The city government recently opened a new public library featuring outdoor gardens.
examples.zh: 市政府最近隆重啟用了一座嶄新的市立圖書館，內部規劃了優雅的戶外綠色庭園。

examples.en: Prices of fresh vegetables have risen slightly recently due to seasonal typhoons.
examples.zh: 受到接連幾場季節性颱風外圍環流影響，最近市場上的生鮮葉菜價格微幅上漲。

examples.en: Mom was cooking dinner; meanwhile, Dad set the dining table.
examples.zh: 媽媽正在廚房煮晚餐；與此同時，爸爸在擺設餐桌。

examples.en: Engineers repaired the railway signal system; meanwhile, shuttle buses transported commuters.
examples.zh: 鐵路維修人員冒雨搶修號誌通訊系統；與此同時，接駁公車全力疏運通勤旅客。

examples.en: The cake was baking inside the warm oven; meanwhile, we whipped sweet fresh cream.
examples.zh: 蛋糕正放在溫熱烤箱裡烘烤，與此同時，我們拿著打蛋器打發香甜滑順的新鮮鮮奶油。
